items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: we had all the movie stars comin' down there...Mrs. Roosevelt ...Sophie Tucker

ctx.x: She had the only dressing room. She had her private dressing room, and it was right near the steps as you go out the back way. So they had a...one of them old-time pianos with a mandolino attachment to it...self-player...used to be a self-player pianos--one o' them old-time pianos. So that's what, uh, Albert Ammons was playin' on ...Meade Lux Lewis. They play...they played single, and then they played together. Well, they playin' a boogie woogie. So me an' Pete Johnson showed up so they got used to usin' two…

So, then, uh, Hazel Scott come out here to make a picture. Meantime, we had all the movie stars comin' down there...Mrs. Roosevelt ...Sophie Tucker...every big-time entertainer was in the business come down there.
